title: PQNK Media Knowledge Record
$comment: REVISION 1.2: authenticated source list is now LOCKED to exactly three channels/pages (see sourcePlatform/channelOrPage below and MEDIA_INGESTION_PLAN.md sec 2) -- www.facebook.com/Pedaver, youtube.com/@pedaverpqnk3167, youtube.com/@aasifsharif. Authentication of the source does not mean every old statement automatically overrides current doctrine -- SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY.md's tier/conflict rules still apply per-record. Not implemented in V1 (Science + Papers + Farmer Advisory only) -- this schema defines the architecture Media indexing will use once that phase begins.
description: Draft schema for Ask PQNK 1.2 — architecture only, not yet implemented, not part of V1. Normalizes YouTube and Facebook source video/post metadata plus segment-level indexing so a 45-minute lecture can be cited at the exact timestamp that answers a farmer's question. Reuses the controlled vocabularies already live in src/lib/content/knowledge/taxonomy.json wherever the concept overlaps with Knowledge Paper metadata, so retrieval can search Papers, Science, Farmer Advisory, and Media against one shared taxonomy rather than four parallel ones.

id.description: Stable internal ID, independent of platform video ID (so a YouTube/Facebook cross-post can share one record — see relatedRecordIds).

sourcePlatform.description: Extend this enum, don't branch the schema, if a third platform is added later.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical URL of the source video or post.

relatedRecordIds.description: IDs of other Media Records that are the same underlying content cross-posted to another platform. See MEDIA_INGESTION_PLAN.md for cross-post detection.

channelOrPage.description: REVISION 1.2: constrained to the three LOCKED authenticated Pedaver/PQNK sources (MEDIA_INGESTION_PLAN.md sec 2). Adding a source requires a documented decision, not a schema-level free-text entry — see MEDIA_INGESTION_PLAN.md sec 2's process for adding a new approved source.

publishedDate.description: ISO date, as published on the source platform.

language.description: Primary spoken language of the source media. 'Mixed' covers common code-switching (e.g. Urdu/English in one lecture) — segment-level transcript still carries the actual words used.

speaker.description: Primary speaker/presenter, e.g. 'Asif Sharif', 'Farmer — name withheld', 'Pedaver Field Team'.

contentType.description: Who is speaking and in what capacity — drives the authority ceiling in SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY.md §5. This is distinct from evidenceType (what kind of support the content offers).

evidenceType.description: Reuses the exact evidenceTypes enum already live in taxonomy.json for Knowledge Papers, so Ask PQNK can rank evidence quality identically across Papers and Media.

authorityStatus.description: Reuses the exact authorityStatus enum already live in taxonomy.json. Set at the WHOLE-RECORD level as a default; individual segments may override this if one segment of a long video is historical while another is current (see segments[].authorityStatus).

crops.description: Union of all crops discussed anywhere in the video/post. Prefer tagging at the segment level; this is the roll-up for whole-record browsing.

problemFamilies.description: Roll-up of taxonomy.json problemFamilies touched anywhere in this record.

scienceDomains.description: The 10 canonical Science domains — identical enum to SCIENTIFIC_DOMAINS in taxonomy.ts.

machinery.description: Canonical machinery names from taxonomy.json machineryTools keys, e.g. 'Raised Bed Shaper (PQNK machine)'.

questionsAnswered.description: Roll-up of segment-level questionsAnswered — used for whole-record search fallback when segment boundaries are still coarse.

farmerLanguage.description: Colloquial/regional terms actually used in the transcript (e.g. local names for a pest or symptom), captured so retrieval can match farmer phrasing that doesn't appear in the canonical taxonomy. Distinct from 'language' (which language was spoken).

fieldLocation.description: Free-text location if disclosed (district/region), for regional-relevance ranking. Omit if not disclosed — do not infer.

transcript.description: Full transcript, kept at the record level; segments reference it by time range rather than duplicating text.

segments.description: Segment-level records — see SEGMENT-LEVEL INDEXING. A long lecture is never treated as one indivisible citation.

relatedKnowledgePapers.description: Slugs of related Knowledge Papers (matches Paper.slug in papers.ts).

relatedScience.description: Science page paths this record supports, e.g. '/science/water'.

relatedFarmerAdvisories.description: REVISION 1.1 addition. IDs of Farmer Advisory records (QA_KNOWLEDGE_SCHEMA.json) this media segment supports or is cited by — e.g. a video demonstration that backs up an approved Advisory's practicalAction. Cross-linking runs both directions: the Advisory record's relatedMedia and this field should stay in sync.

reviewStatus.description: Pipeline status distinct from authorityStatus — a record can be 'Approved' for indexing while its authorityStatus is 'Requires PQNK Review' (i.e., it's safely indexed and searchable, but not yet cleared to found an authoritative answer).

ingestionNotes.description: Free-text reviewer notes, e.g. why a segment was marked Historical.

summary.description: Short human-readable label, e.g. 'Why flooded soil damages roots'.

transcriptExcerpt.description: The transcript slice for this time range, stored redundantly for fast retrieval without re-slicing the full transcript at query time.

questionsAnswered.description: The specific farmer-facing question(s) this segment answers — the primary retrieval key at segment granularity.

authorityStatus.description: Overrides the record-level authorityStatus for this segment only. Required when a single long video mixes current guidance with a now-superseded explanation in different segments.
